title: Muse Spark Open
summary: Meta AI releases Muse Spark Open, a massive 816 billion parameter open-source generative AI model, making their state-of-the-art generative capabilities available to researchers and developers worldwide through HuggingFace.
problem_solved: Democratizes access to large-scale generative AI by open-sourcing a 816B parameter model previously only available via closed API.
why_valuable: Provides the research community and developers with free access to one of the largest open-source generative models, enabling innovation without API costs or restrictions.
